links.outcome: Physician task load, burnout, and usability before vs after ambient AI scribe pilot
links.effect: Task load fell by 24.42 points (p <.001), burnout fell by 1.94 points (p <.001), and usability rose by 10.9 points (p <.001) in paired analysis (n = 38).
links.quote: Paired survey analysis (n = 38) revealed large statistically significant reductions in task load (-24.42, p <.001) and burnout (-1.94, p <.001), and moderate statistically significant improvements in usability scores (+10.9, p <.001).

screen.reason: Prospective quality improvement pilot implementation study evaluating the real-world deployment of an ambient AI scribe (DAX Copilot) on physician burnout and documentation burden.
